purpose: Human-reviewable plan consumed by Scripts/release_sanctuary_balance.py: tone the sanctuary golds toward a physically plausible gold with low-frequency world-space variation, give the Kodesh partition the book's gold lining instead of the blown-out hammered PBR instance, stop the gold floor mirroring, trim the entrance fill and add highlight roll-off in the post-process volume. Answers the 20260907T214622Z renders d_heikhal_west_vessels / e_kodesh_aron_keruvim (rear wall to white, flat synthetic yellow gold, mechanical frieze repetition, harsh highlights). Every number is an artistic proposal read back numerically; nothing here claims visual acceptance. Astra's lighting values (morning sun, EV 0..14 histogram exposure, fill, fog) are refined, never undone.
lastKnownMapSha256Note: AGENTS.md dove/resident integration save. Recorded as matched/not matched only, never a guard: other native jobs re-save the map; run strictly serial after checking live UnrealEditor PIDs.
protectedAssetsNote: The PBR master and the hammered-gold instance dress 587 exterior gold components (dentils, roof, anti-bird points); the canonical golds are the pre-PBR donors. None of them may change: the partition is re-pointed at the veneer gold at the component level instead.

gold.why: Measured gold reflectance (linear, F0 about 1.00/0.71/0.29 in sRGB primaries) instead of the saturated 1.0/0.766/0.336 study colour; metallic 1 so the diffuse term is zero and the surface reads through its reflections, not as yellow paint.

variation.graph: WorldPosition -> Divide(scaleCm) -> Noise(-1..1, Perlin/gradient ALU) -> Multiply(roughnessAmplitude) -> Add(existing roughness node) -> Clamp -> Roughness. Tint: (WorldPosition + offset) / scaleCm -> Noise -> Multiply(tintAmplitude) -> Add(1.0) -> Multiply(existing Constant3Vector) -> BaseColor. 10 m features: neighbouring 250 cm frieze panels differ by up to +-0.06 roughness and +-3 percent tint, so no two panels read identical while the hammered-relief lerp of the frieze material is kept.
variation.why: The frieze already varies roughness with relief height (0.45 ground -> 0.35 raised); what the renders lack is variation ACROSS panels. World-space noise costs one ALU noise per pass and no texture; it is applied only to the veneer and frieze materials (walls), not to the vessels, where a 10 m feature would be invisible.

vessels.usageNote: M_AronStudyV3_Gold dresses RELEASE_Aron_Body/Lid, RELEASE_Menorah and the Aron poles (third-party vessels spec first gold candidate); M_HeikhalKeilim_Gold the incense altar / shulchan studies; M_KeruvimStudyGold the 100 slots of RELEASE_Keruvim_1. A listed material with no component in the map is recorded and skipped.

partition.bookBasis: SourceAssets/research/book-scene-requirements-20260907.json p.222 (41:16) and p.231 (41:17): cedar-over-stone lining overlaid with gold on ALL walls of the Heikhal and Kodesh HaKodashim, floor to ceiling, above the door and behind the doors; status certain (Rashi). The partition's Heikhal face is therefore gold, not off-white stone.
partition.note: Component-level override on three measured architecture pieces (both faces and the doorway jambs become gold). The keruv/palm relief the book also demands on this wall (p.238) is a follow-up: the frieze V2 spec skipped this wall for lack of a veneer actor.

roughnessSource.measurement: System.Drawing decode of the frozen JPG, every 4th pixel (262144 samples), 2026-09-07; the roughness_2k.jpg gives 0.2845.

floor.roughnessScaleRule: targetRoughness / measuredMean01 = 0.5 / 0.2849 = 1.755, giving a mean roughness of 0.50 (p10 0.40, p90 0.60) through the master's Multiply(ARM.G, RoughnessScale). The previous 1.1 made the floor a 0.31 mirror.
floor.tintNote: With AlbedoFlatness 1.0 the Tint IS the base colour; the pale [0.578, 0.509, 0.328] at metallic 0.8 is the 'synthetic yellow'. Tint becomes gold.linear, metallic 1.

fill.label: RELEASE_HeikhalEntranceFill
fill.why: Receipt value 25,000 cd exceeds the 15,000 cd threshold; 15,000 (-0.74 stop) keeps the side walls and vessels lifted while cutting the fill's rectangle reflection on the floor and partition gold. The partition blow-out itself is the 24 klux sun patch, which the exposure changes below address.

postProcess.labelAfter: V3 cinematic exposure - histogram EV 0-14, filmic, local exposure

expectedExposureBounds.source: SourceAssets/lighting-review/native-interior-exposure-20260907T214522053469Z.json verifiedMin/MaxBrightness (EV 0 and EV 14 with ExtendDefaultLuminanceRange off)

notes.local_exposure_highlight_contrast_scale: Bilateral local exposure at 0.8 compresses the sunlit partition patch toward the frame's midtones (about -0.6 stop on the brightest region) without lifting shadows or changing the global EV 0..14 metering.
notes.film_white_clip: 0.04 -> 0.02 gives the filmic curve about half a stop more headroom before the whites clip.
notes.film_shoulder: 0.26 -> 0.30: a slightly stronger shoulder rolls the gold highlights off instead of clipping them; slope 0.9 and toe 0.55 are untouched.

limitations: Every value is an artistic proposal read back numerically; no still, walk or packaged acceptance is established by this script.
Gold reflectance, roughness and the 10 m variation are reconstruction choices, not sourced surfaces; the book specifies gold-over-cedar lining, not its finish.
The Kodesh partition receives plain gold; the keruv/palm relief the book also requires on that wall is still missing (frieze V2 skipped the wall).
Material .uasset edits are shared assets: donor/review maps that reference the same materials look different afterwards although their .umap bytes are unchanged.

Revert restores the material .uasset bytes from the checkpoint and the map properties from the receipt; a material already loaded in the reverting process can read back stale until a fresh process confirms (run -BalanceDryRun afterwards).
